T-013: This marker can only be replaced by Rule Card effects. The following effects are only applied if a "Labyrinth Layout" Rule is active. Monsters here are in the Tilemap. During your Main Phase your Non-Flying monsters can move one time per turn through unobstructed Tiles up to a number of Tiles equal to their Level. Monsters moving from their starting tile for the first time require one additional movement. Monsters on the same side of the field can be on the same Tile.
